runs.agent_notes: Exhaustive search (20 WebSearch calls across web/news/gov/video/social/image/book channels, Hindi and English, plus 9 WebFetch pulls) found NO source that names a village 'Rina'/'रिणा'/'Reena'/'रीणा'/'रिना'/'Rinna' in Bikaner/Lunkaransar/Mahajan. Two Patrika articles specifically about the 34-village Mahajan Field Firing Range displacement (2018, 2022) name other displaced villages (Bhojraser, Kumhana, Motlai, Khaniser, Thoia, Manera, Duder, Dantaur, Khajuwala, Pugal, Mohangadh, Nachna) but never Rina, so they were NOT attached here per the no-bare-mention rule.
